originalTitle: BigXthaPlug feat. Belly Gang Kushington - LITE (Official Music Video)
content: The official music video for LITE by BigXthaPlug feat.@bellygangkushington 🔔 Subscribe to BigXthaPlug's channel: https://bit.ly/3SLQimL LITE feat. Belly Gang Kushington: https://bigxthaplug.sym.fm/lite-feat-belly-gang-kushington Text BigXthaPlug: +1(469)727-1250 Message BigXthaPlug directly: https://link.rivetapp.co/BigXthaPlug Directed By Jerry Morka Co-Directed by BigXthaPlug Follow BigXthaPlug: https://www.instagram.com/bigxthaplug https://twitter.com/BigXthaPlugg https://www.tiktok.com/@bigxthaplug_ https://www.facebook.com/p/bigxthaplug-100063805581381/ https://www.bigxthaplugofficial.com/ Everything BigX: https://bigxthaplug.komi.io/ “LITE” is the new single from Dallas rapper BigXthaPlug featuring Atlanta rapper Belly Gang Kushington. The official music video brings together BigXthaPlug’s bass-heavy Texas rap and Southern hip-hop sound with Belly Gang Kushington’s melodic Atlanta style, connecting two rising voices from the current Southern rap scene. Known for songs including “Texas,” “Mmhmm,” and “The Largest,” BigXthaPlug continues his run of new music with “LITE,” his latest hip-hop collaboration with Belly Gang Kushington. #BigXthaPlug #LITE #BellyGangKushington
